en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2729 - In the narration of Al-Bazanti from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir,
he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a person in the state of ihram who killed a fox.

Imam (as) said: "They must offer a blood sacrifice."
I asked: "What about a rabbit?"
Imam (as) said: "The same as for the fox."
